basis: Accepted CIKM paper: 47 meta-training datasets are disjoint from 23 held-out evaluation datasets.
roadmap_wording_resolution.roadmap_reference_1_6_2_1_policy: The roadmap's broader-evaluation reference is not used as permission to access the final 23 held-out datasets. Until a protocol amendment explicitly says otherwise, Phase 15 explanation-correctness work must use development/non-held-out evidence.

operational_policy: The 47 development/meta-training split remains frozen and may be used for development phases.
The 23 datasets are final held-out evaluation datasets, not meta-training datasets.
Current repository history does not contain their 23 authoritative dataset IDs; no names may be invented.
No Phase 10-17 code may load, inspect, tune on, or derive metrics from the final held-out dataset contents.
Phase 18 is blocked until the exact 23 identities are recovered from authoritative project history, populated in test_v1_23.yaml, checked for zero overlap with train_v1_47, and frozen.
